set.body: Plan: turn the current renderer-neutral grammar, scales, axes, and scene IR into a usable plot pipeline: Plot[Row] -> trained/resolved plot IR -> Scene -> backend renderers. Scope stays in modules/graphics plus backend conformance tests in modules/graphics-svg. Acceptance: child slices add a typed compiler spine, scale training and row diagnostics, layout/guides, conformance tests, and one domain-export integration path, all verified on JVM and JS.
set.title: Epic: graphics plot compiler and backend-neutral build-out
